test_knn_points_square: test knn_points on uniform batched point clouds across CPU and CUDA devices
test_knn_points_ragged: test knn_points on ragged point clouds with variable lengths per batch element
test_knn_gather: test knn_gather to retrieve nearest neighbor point values by index from source points
test_knn_check_version: test knn_check_version to validate which KNN algorithm version supports given dimensions and K
test_knn_backward_grads: test backward gradient computation through knn_points for both square and ragged point sets
